query:
WITH population_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region AS region_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) AS population_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
    WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE 
      AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
      AND TRIM(hl.region) != '' 
      AND hl.region IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY hl.region
),
jobs_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        employer_work_region AS region_name,
        COUNT(*) AS active_jobs_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala
    WHERE is_active_job = 1
      AND employer_work_region IS NOT NULL
      AND employer_work_region NOT IN ('لاينطبق', 'غير معرف')
    GROUP BY employer_work_region
)
SELECT 
    p.region_name,
    p.population_count,
    COALESCE(j.active_jobs_count, 0) AS active_jobs_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.population_count > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(j.active_jobs_count, 0) * 100.0 / p.population_count, 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS jobs_per_100_people
FROM population_by_region p
LEFT JOIN jobs_by_region j ON p.region_name = j.region_name
ORDER BY p.population_count DESC LIMIT 1200
